detailed_description: ICS File Generator - Generate iCalendar event text from a title, start and end date, start and end time, timezone, location, and description. The tool formats a VCALENDAR and VEVENT block with DTSTART, DTEND, SUMMARY, LOCATION, DESCRIPTION, and a deterministic UID, then shows the event date, duration, and timezone before you copy the text.
usage_steps: Enter the event title, start and end date, start and end time, and timezone
Add optional location and description details
Review the generated iCalendar text, event date, duration, and timezone
Copy the output and test it with your calendar workflow before sharing widely
usage_examples: Draft an ICS block for a product planning meeting
Check that a one-hour UTC event has the expected DTSTART and DTEND values
Prepare calendar event text for an email, documentation page, or internal note

faqs.question: Is the ICS File Generator free?
faqs.answer: Yes. The generator runs in the browser and does not require an account.

faqs.question: Does the page download a calendar file?
faqs.answer: No. It generates iCalendar text on the page. Copy the output and save or import it with your own calendar tools.

faqs.question: How are timezones handled?
faqs.answer: The timezone field is included in the generated DTSTART and DTEND lines unless you use UTC, which is written with a Z suffix.
